description.value: Fort St. John Co-op is a locally-owned Federated Co-operative serving Fort St. John and the Prespatou area in northeastern BC. It operates primarily as a fuel and convenience outlet, offering propane refills, cardlock bulk fuel access, and a car wash alongside convenience goods. As a member-owned co-operative embedded in this Peace Region hub, it is a practical roadside stop for tourers travelling the Alaska Highway corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a Federated Co-operatives convenience store at 10808 91 Avenue, Fort St. John. The website confirms an active Fort St. John Co-op serving Fort St. John and Prespatou, and the tags subpage reveals the location's primary services: bulk propane/propane refills, cardlock/bulk fuel, car wash, and convenience — pointing to a fuel-and-convenience operation rather than a full grocery store. The website rendered with heavy CMS template noise and did not surface specific amenity details (no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or product listings), so most amenity fields default to null despite OSM carrying a toilets=yes tag.
